en: Colorized vintage postcard view over a green hilly valley with scattered farmhouses and village buildings. A river with a stone bridge curves through the foreground. In the mid‑ground there is a mill or factory complex with white buildings and a tall red smokestack, surrounded by trees. More houses are dispersed across the fields and forested hills in the distance. A cursive German caption is printed along the lower border.
